jobs.title: Brand Operations Lead, Fulfillment
jobs.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

We're looking for a senior operator to own how brand onboarding works for Fulfilled by Faire (FbF) , not just how individual brands get live.

Our specialist team runs brands from commitment to activation today. This role sits above that. You'll own the program itself: the KPIs, the dashboard that tells us whether onboarding is healthy, and the roadmap that fixes what keeps breaking.

FbF is scaling from roughly 1% to 20% of GMV. Onboarding cannot be the thing that breaks on the way there. Your job is to make sure it doesn't, by building leverage rather than absorbing volume.

You'll also set the bar for the specialist team. You'll write the playbooks, coach people on root-cause rigor and brand communication, and raise the standard around you. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports. Your influence comes from judgment, evidence and follow-through.

Expect 20-25% travel to our fulfillment nodes, and warehouse partners.

What you’ll do

Own the onboarding system

- Own the end-to-end onboarding experience for brands joining FbF, from commitment through activation and post-launch stabilization

- Be accountable for the KPIs

- Carry a focused portfolio of strategic and at-risk brands yourself while the team handles day-to-day volume

- Diagnose ambiguous, high-impact problems independently

Build the measurement layer

- Monitor and recommend improvements the FbF onboarding KPI set

- Document the definitions with Analytics so the numbers mean the same thing to everyone

- Build and maintain the dashboard leadership reads

- Run the weekly onboarding operating review

- Use the data to see capacity constraints and bottlenecks coming early enough to plan

Drive strategic improvement

- Define and sequence a rolling 3-6 month improvement roadmap, prioritized by business impact

- Lead complex cross-functional pilots from hypothesis to measured result

- Find leverage through automation, self-serve and playbooks so throughput grows faster than headcount

- Insist on structural fixes and track corrective actions to verified closure

Own three cross-functional lanes

- Product roadmap partnership. Be the named ops counterpart to FbF Product. Write the problem briefs, quantify the impact, and represent onboarding in prioritization.

- Onboarding enablement and playbooks. Own the SOP library and how new specialists ramp, onboarding enablement, talk track, etc.

- 3PL and network readiness. Own receiving-standard readiness and the inbound exception playbook as we add nodes, so a new facility can take FbF volume without a bespoke launch.

Raise the bar around you

- Personally guide through onboarding our largest (Platinum +) brands

- Coach the specialist team on root-cause rigor, brand communication and operational judgment, without direct authority

- Run the escalation review and make your standard for closure the team's standard

- Communicate at every altitude: floor detail with warehouse partners, executive narrative with leadership, honest updates with brands when things slip

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

- 3+ years in client facing fulfillment operations, seller onboarding, marketplace operations, or a related field

- Hands-on experience with physical goods fulfillment and warehousing, ideally in a 3PL setting

- Ownership of an operational KPI you personally moved

- Experience defining metrics and building your own reporting

- Track record of resolving ambiguous problems independently and driving cross-functional work to closure through influence rather than authority

- Structured root cause analysis, and the judgment to tell a symptomatic fix from a structural one

- Experience working directly with brands, merchants or partners across seniority levels

- Strong communication, including taking operational complexity to a leadership audience without losing fidelity

Preferred qualifications

- Scaled a marketplace or seller onboarding program through a step change in volume

- Stood up operations at a new 3PL node or fulfillment center

- Working knowledge of WMS/OMS and how configuration shows up on the floor

- Designed or launched a self-serve or automated flow that removed manual steps

- Owned an SOP library or enablement program

- Comfort using AI tooling to compress analysis, documentation etc.

- Prior online marketplace experience

Location and travel

Hybrid role based in San Francisco and New York  with up to 20% travel to fulfillment nodes, and partner reviews.

Salary Range

San Francisco and New York : The pay range for this role is $ 116,000 to $ 159,500   per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Why you’ll love working at Faire

- Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.

- Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.

- Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.

- Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.

- Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog .

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Brand Growth is one of Faire's top company objectives - it's one of the biggest levers we have to unlock retailer share of wallet and enable retailers to do more and more of their spend on Faire. As a Strategy & Operations Senior Lead, you'll take end-to-end ownership of our Enterprise opportunity globally, across NAM, Europe, and future markets - defining how we identify, win, and grow our largest and most strategic brand partners. You'll operate as a senior individual contributor with significant scope: setting the strategic agenda, driving the analyses and business cases that shape it, and leading the cross-functional execution that turns strategy into results.

You'll partner closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Program Management to build the go-to-market motion, operating cadence, and investment priorities for Enterprise, and you'll regularly present performance, insights, and recommendations to cross-functional leadership. Beyond scaling today's Enterprise motion, you'll explore entirely new opportunities to unlock supply growth - from 1P fulfillment models to deeper business development partnerships. You won't have direct reports, but you will be a de facto leader on the team - setting direction for how Enterprise is prioritized, and acting as a thought partner and mentor to other Strategy & Operations teammates.

This is an ideal role for someone who wants outsized ownership of a high-visibility, high-growth, global area of the business - combining deep analytical rigor with the strategic judgment and cross-functional influence to drive a new opportunity from thesis to scaled execution.

What you’ll do

- Own the global Enterprise opportunity end-to-end across NAM, Europe, and future markets - set the strategy, size the opportunity, and build the roadmap to capture it

- Shape pricing strategy and other core commercial and go-to-market levers for our largest brand partners

- Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives with Product, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Program Management, turning strategy into measurable business impact

- Explore and stand up entirely new opportunities to unlock supply growth, from 1P fulfillment to deeper business development partnerships

- Own the most important Enterprise metrics - tracking performance, surfacing the most salient insights, and building scalable operational processes to close gaps

- Regularly present Enterprise performance and strategic recommendations to Faire's broader leadership team

- Act as a thought partner and informal mentor to other Strategy & Operations teammates

Qualifications

- 8+ years of relevant work experience in an analytical and strategic role across Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Consulting, or Finance

- Experience owning a strategic initiative or business area end-to-end, ideally including exposure to Enterprise, key account, or B2B go-to-market motions

- Experience with pricing strategy, global/international expansion, or new business model development is a plus

- You are a strategic problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and apply a first-principles approach to solving them

- You are highly analytical and metrics-focused. You can execute complex analyses, define KPIs, size opportunity areas, and measure and report on performance across the business

- Advanced technical skill set with strong proficiency in Excel + SQL

- You're fluent with AI tools and use them to move faster - accelerating analysis, research, and execution

- You are a strong communicator who can crisply translate data-driven insights into recommendations for audiences up to and including senior leadership

- You have strong product and business intuition, and can contextualize insights within broader business goals

- You are highly collaborative and can influence and drive results through others, without relying on formal authority

- You are scrappy and resourceful - when something needs to get done, you find a way to make it happen

- You are an extraordinarily fast learner with the curiosity and intellectual horsepower to master new topics quickly
